{{Short description|Japanese mathematician}}

{{Nihongo|'''Gen'ichirō Sunouchi'''|洲之内 源一郎|Sunouchi Gen'ichirō|29 October 1911 – 7 March 2008}}<ref>[https://www.ams.org/notices/200805/tx080500617p.pdf Notice of death]</ref> was a Japanese [[mathematician]] working on [[Fourier series]] and analysis.<ref>Collection of articles dedicated to Gen'ichirō Sunouchi on his sixtieth birthday. Tōhoku Math. J. (2) 24 (1972), no. 2. The Tōhoku University, Sendai, 1971. pp. 109–370.</ref> He authored over 90 articles written in collaboration with 17 coauthors. The [[Sunouchi operators]] are named after him.<ref>{{citation
 | last = Weisz | first = F.
 | doi = 10.1007/BF00053702 | doi-access = 
 | issue = 1–2
 | journal = [[Acta Mathematica Hungarica]]
 | mr = 1405222
 | pages = 121–152
 | title = The boundedness of the two-parameter Sunouchi operators on Hardy spaces
 | volume = 72
 | year = 1996| s2cid = 121719528
 }}.</ref>

==Selected publications==

*Sunouchi, Gen'ichirō, [https://www.ams.org/mathscinet-getitem?mr=0041259 On the Walsh-Kaczmarz series]. Proc. Amer. Math. Soc. 2, (1951). 5–11. 
*Sunouchi, Gen'ichirō, [http://projecteuclid.org/euclid.tmj/1178243709 Strong summability of Walsh-Fourier series]. Tōhoku Math. J. (2) 16 1964 228–237.
*Sunouchi, Gen'ichirō, [http://projecteuclid.org/euclid.tmj/1178245769 Notes on Fourier analysis. XVIII. Absolute summability of series with constant terms]. Tōhoku Math. J. (2) 1, (1949). 57–65.
*Kaneko, Makoto; Sunouchi, Gen'ichirō, [http://projecteuclid.org/euclid.tmj/1178228647 On the Littlewood-Paley and Marcinkiewicz functions in higher dimensions]. Tōhoku Math. J. (2) 37 (1985), no. 3, 343–365.
